title: NBA Sim RNG Contract (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Freezes the RNG algorithm, seed type, stream model, and substream policy for the kernel. Foundation 0.1.0 locks mulberry32 with a single explicitly-threaded RNG stream and forbids substreams. Any change to a field pinned by `const` here is a breaking change requiring a foundation_version major bump per docs/foundation/README.md.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the RNG contract. Must equal config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

algorithm.description: Authoritative PRNG algorithm for v0.1.0. mulberry32 is a 32-bit-state, deterministic, seedable algorithm returning floats in [0,1). Changing algorithm is a major-version bump.

seed_type.description: Seed is an unsigned 32-bit integer. Same seed produces the identical draw sequence across conformant implementations (decision M3).

stream_model.description: Exactly one RNG instance is threaded through step() per simulation. Multiple named streams, substreams, or per-module RNGs are forbidden.

substreams.description: Hard toggle forbidding substreams (rng.duration(...), rng.resolve(...), etc.). Must remain false for v0.1.0; introducing substreams is a major-version bump.
